portal_description:
The resource-agents packages provide the Pacemaker and RGManager service managers with a set of scripts. These scripts interface with several services to allow operating in a high-availability (HA) environment.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [TNF] podman-etcd should start etcd pod with same oom_score_adj as system-node-critical [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-113109)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should keep container for debugging purposes [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-113811)

* [TNF] podman-etcd shall sync on force_new_cluster attribute at start [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-116209)

* [TNF] podman-etcd shall promote etcd member [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-119503)

* [RFE] db2: add "skip_basic_sql_health_check" parameter to avoid failing on systems with high load [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123284)

* [RFE] db2: add "monitor_retries", "monitor_sleep", and "monitor_retry_all_errors" parameters to be able to avoid failing on first try [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123287)

* DB2 resource agent encounters "race condition" upon cluster re-integration [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123293)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should implement a dynamic revision bump to optimize Etcd resource utilization [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-124205)

* podman-etcd should coordinate recovery with peer in case of local etcd container failure [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-126086)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should automatically detect certificate rotation and restart etcd container [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-124202)

* [TNF] podman-etcd resource agent should clean up stale learner attributes [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-131184)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should prevent simultaneous etcd members removal [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-130579)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should wrap ipv6 address in brackets for attribute_node_ip [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-113814)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should exclude stopping resources from active count [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-127892)

* [TNF] podman-etcd should prevent retries on fatal start errors [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-132051)
